title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Two removals that were deleting live code
summary: Applying every removal the extension offers on a 6300 file project broke the build twice. Both holes are closed, and the three bulk commands the family was missing are here.

highlights.title: The R class reached without spelling R
highlights.description: A colour written as color.name after import ca.foo.R.color was invisible to the scan, so two live colours were reported dead and deleted. Aliases and an aliased R class count now too.

highlights.title: A name between backticks is never reported
highlights.description: The mention harvest looks for identifiers, so it cannot see a backtick name at a call site. A called member came back unreferenced, and its quick fix deleted live code.

highlights.title: The declaration and its tests, together
highlights.description: One command removes what is kept alive only by its own tests, and those tests, in a single Refactor Preview. A test that also covers something else is left alone.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Resource keys and resource files reached through an imported R class count as referenced, under all three spellings.
Neither the symbol detector nor the member detector reports a name written between backticks: absence cannot be proven for a name the harvest cannot look for.

sections.heading: Improvements
bullets: Remove Code Used Only by Tests, With Its Tests: the declaration and the tests that exercise it, in one preview.
Make Every Self Only Member Private: 142 lightbulbs on a real project, one command now.
A removal takes the imports it leaves with no user, and deletes the file when nothing but a package line remains.
